# Initial loading rebuilds when replay expires before it finishes

<!-- Generated by tests/e2e. Regenerate with ATLAS_E2E_UPDATE=1; review every change. -->

## 1. Enroll Alpha with a change log that retains five changes

SDK `GET /dataset` with <enrollment key>

→ **200**
```json
{
  "id": "<id-1>",
  "writing_release": "0.1.0"
}
```

SDK `POST /entities` with <enrollment key>
```json
{
  "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
  "id": "<alpha>",
  "request_id": "<alpha request>",
  "kind": "asset",
  "credential": "<alpha credential>",
  "alias": "Alpha"
}
```

→ **201**
```json
{
  "asset": {
    "alias": "Alpha",
    "change_sequence": 1,
    "command_manifest": [],
    "components": {
      "communications": {
        "link_state": "offline"
      },
      "heartbeat": {
        "last_seen": null
      },
      "status": {
        "reported_at": null,
        "value": "unknown"
      }
    },
    "dataset_id": "<id-1>",
    "id": "<alpha>",
    "kind": "asset",
    "subtype": null,
    "version": 1
  },
  "credential_id": "<id-2>",
  "principal_id": "<id-3>"
}
```
